themes.note: Both themes are first-class. Each CSS role token has a stock (light) and vinyl (dark) value; the frontmatter lists both as named colours.

display.purpose: Page titles and the library heading with count; uppercase, 72% width.

headline.purpose: Inspector track title only; 16px and three-line clamp below 760px tall.

body.purpose: Row and dock titles, buttons, nav labels, descriptions; tabular figures.

label.purpose: Section labels, metadata, badges, inputs, chips, timestamps; sentence case.

marker.purpose: The manual-correction provenance mark, nowhere else.

shadows.name: pop-stock
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, dropdown menus, tooltips in the light theme.

shadows.name: pop-vinyl
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, dropdown menus, tooltips in the dark theme.

shadows.name: record-edge
shadows.purpose: The platter rim in the playback dock.

shadows.name: nav-selection-rule
shadows.purpose: 1px stamp-blue rule on the active nav item.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focused text inputs, alongside the stamp-blue outline.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Panels are flat; depth is tonal.

motion.name: platter-spin
motion.purpose: 33 1/3 rpm while audio plays; paused in place when it stops. The only unprompted motion.

motion.name: ease-smooth-out
motion.purpose: Default for state, overlay open/close, panel and position changes.

motion.name: duration-quick
motion.purpose: Nav and small control hover, overlay close.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Buttons, dropdown and modal open, tabs, theme change.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations collapse to ~0
motion.purpose: Honoured from the OS setting and the in-app override (data-reduce-motion).

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Page padding 16px 18px; inspector disc shrinks to 76px inline; headline drops to 16px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a surface: stamp-blue fill, 2px pressed corner.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:32px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:2px; background:var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf); color:var(--sonic-accent-fg, #ffffff); font:600 13.5px/1 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf) 86%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default button: transparent with a strong one-pixel rule.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:32px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--sonic-border-strong, #a9a9a0); border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:var(--sonic-fg, #151515); font:600 13.5px/1 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--sonic-surface-2, #e8e8e3); border-color:var(--sonic-fg-subtle, #64645d); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action: promo-red rule and text, never filled.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:32px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--sonic-danger, #c4232f); border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:var(--sonic-danger, #c4232f); font:600 13.5px/1 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--sonic-danger, #c4232f) 12%, transparent); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Transparent field with a softened rule; focus turns the rule stamp blue and lifts the ground.
components.html: <label class="ds-input-wrap"><svg class="ds-input-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input class="ds-input" placeholder="Search title, producer, key" /></label>
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; width:280px; } .ds-input-icon { position:absolute; left:12px; color:var(--sonic-fg-subtle, #64645d); pointer-events:none; } .ds-input { width:100%; height:32px; padding:0 10px 0 38px; border:1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--sonic-border-strong, #a9a9a0) 60%, transparent); border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:var(--sonic-fg, #151515); caret-color:var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf); font:400 12px/1.5 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; outline:none; transition:border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--sonic-fg-subtle, #64645d); } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--sonic-border-strong, #a9a9a0); } .ds-input:focus { border-color:var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf); background:var(--sonic-surface, #fbfbf9); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf) 7%, transparent); }

components.name: Nav Rail
components.description: 196px rail; the active item sits on stock with a 1px stamp-blue rule and a stamp-blue icon.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; width:196px; padding:16px 12px; border-right:1px solid var(--sonic-border, #d6d6cf); background:var(--sonic-bg, #f4f4f1); } .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; height:36px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:var(--sonic-fg-muted, #45453f); font:600 13.5px/1 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-item svg { color:var(--sonic-fg-subtle, #64645d); flex-shrink:0; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--sonic-surface-2, #e8e8e3) 60%, transparent); color:var(--sonic-fg, #151515); } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background:var(--sonic-surface-2, #e8e8e3); color:var(--sonic-fg, #151515); box-shadow:inset 1px 0 0 var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf); } .ds-nav-item.is-active svg { color:var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Library toolbar filters; active takes the stamp-blue line, wash and text.
components.css: .ds-chips { display:flex; gap:6px; } .ds-chip { height:28px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid var(--sonic-border, #d6d6cf); border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:var(--sonic-fg-muted, #45453f); font:500 12px/1 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:var(--sonic-border-strong, #a9a9a0); color:var(--sonic-fg, #151515); } .ds-chip.is-active { border-color:color-mix(in oklab, var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf) 40%, transparent); background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf) 14%, transparent); color:var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small status label: neutral on stock, status tones as an 8% wash with a 20% rule.
components.html: WAV 48/24 Tagged Missing file
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:24px; padding:0 8px; border:1px solid var(--sonic-border, #d6d6cf); border-radius:2px; background:var(--sonic-surface-2, #e8e8e3); color:var(--sonic-fg-muted, #45453f); font:500 12px/1 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-badge-success { border-color:color-mix(in oklab, var(--sonic-success, #1b6e44) 20%, transparent); background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--sonic-success, #1b6e44) 8%, transparent); color:var(--sonic-success, #1b6e44); } .ds-badge-danger { border-color:color-mix(in oklab, var(--sonic-danger, #c4232f) 20%, transparent); background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--sonic-danger, #c4232f) 8%, transparent); color:var(--sonic-danger, #c4232f); }

components.name: Provenance Marks
components.description: Signature: tempo and key drawn in the mark of where they came from (printed, stamped, measured with confidence dots, marker).
components.html: 128 from source128 file tag128 measured128 your correction
components.css: .ds-prov { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:4px 16px; color:var(--sonic-fg-subtle, #64645d); font:400 12px/1.5 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-prov b { font-size:13.5px; font-stretch:80%; } .ds-mark-printed { font-weight:700; color:var(--sonic-fg, #151515); } .ds-mark-stamped { display:inline-block; padding:0 4px; border:1.5px solid var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf); color:var(--sonic-accent, #2f3bbf); font-weight:750; line-height:1.25; transform:rotate(-1.5deg); } .ds-mark-measured { font-weight:600; color:var(--sonic-fg-muted, #45453f); text-decoration:underline dotted var(--sonic-fg-subtle, #64645d); text-decoration-thickness:1.5px; text-underline-offset:3px; } .ds-dots { display:inline-flex; gap:2px; margin-left:3px; vertical-align:0.45em; } .ds-dots i { width:3px; height:3px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid var(--sonic-fg-subtle, #64645d); } .ds-dots i.on { background:var(--sonic-fg-muted, #45453f); border-color:var(--sonic-fg-muted, #45453f); } .ds-mark-marker { font-family:'Shantell Sans Variable', 'Segoe Print', cursive; font-weight:750; font-variation-settings:'INFM' 100; font-stretch:100%; color:var(--sonic-fg, #151515); }

components.name: Label Disc
components.description: Signature: the inspected track as a record; without artwork the blank label carries BPM/key in their marks and a promo-red PROMO stamp.
components.html: PROMO1288A
components.css: .ds-disc { position:relative; display:grid; place-items:center; width:176px; aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--sonic-vinyl, #151515); } .ds-groove { position:absolute; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-groove.g1 { inset:4%; } .ds-groove.g2 { inset:11%; border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-groove.g3 { inset:18%; } .ds-label { position:relative; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:14px; width:58%; aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--sonic-label, #fbfbf9); color:#151515; font-family:'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; overflow:hidden; } .ds-label-bpm { font-size:17px; font-weight:700; font-stretch:80%; line-height:1; } .ds-label-key { font-size:10px; font-weight:700; font-stretch:80%; line-height:1; } .ds-promo { position:absolute; top:17%; left:9%; transform:rotate(-14deg); padding:0 2px; border:1.5px solid #c4232f; color:#c4232f; font-size:7px; font-weight:800; font-stretch:72%; letter-spacing:0.04em; line-height:1.25; } .ds-hole { position:absolute; top:50%; left:50%; width:7%; min-width:4px; aspect-ratio:1; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); border-radius:9999px; background:var(--sonic-vinyl, #151515); }

components.name: Platter
components.description: Signature: the dock's 56px record; the centre label turns at 33 1/3 rpm while audio plays.
components.css: .ds-dock { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:12px 20px; border-top:1px solid var(--sonic-border, #d6d6cf); background:var(--sonic-transport, #ebebe6); font-family:'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-platter { position:relative; display:grid; place-items:center; width:56px; height:56px; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--sonic-vinyl, #151515); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--sonic-border-strong, #a9a9a0); } .ds-platter::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:8px; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-platter-label { position:relative; width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--sonic-label, #fbfbf9); animation:ds-spin 1.8s linear infinite; } .ds-platter-label::after { content:''; position:absolute; top:50%; left:50%; width:4px; height:4px; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); border-radius:9999px; background:var(--sonic-vinyl, #151515); } .ds-platter:hover .ds-platter-label { animation-play-state:paused; } .ds-dock-text { display:flex; flex-direction:column; } .ds-dock-text b { font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--sonic-fg, #151515); } .ds-dock-text small { font-size:12px; color:var(--sonic-fg-muted, #45453f); } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform:rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-platter-label { animation:none; } }

narrative.overview:
Every track in Sonic arrives the way an unreleased promo does: black vinyl, a blank white label, and whatever facts somebody printed, stamped or scrawled on it. The interface is that label. Facts are ink on stock; colour is spent only where it carries meaning. A tempo or key value is never just a number: it is drawn in the mark of where it came from, so the producer can read provenance at a glance in a dense table at 2 a.m.

The world has two first-class pressings. Dark is vinyl black under label-white type; light is the label stock itself under ink black. Both use one-pixel rules, square-cut surfaces with a 2px pressed corner on controls, and no glows or gradient fills. Circles belong to records and their labels. Type is Archivo throughout, with condensed caps for pressing-plant headings and figures; Shantell Sans at full informality appears only where the producer's own hand corrected a value.

The system explicitly refuses the category default for audio tools: graphite panels, rounded cards and a violet or blue accent glowing everywhere. Motion is equally restrained: the record on the platter turns at 33⅓ rpm while audio plays and settles when it stops; everything else moves only in response to the user.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (stamp blue) for selection, the primary action and focus; promo red only for loss and error.
Provenance marks: printed, stamped, measured (with three confidence dots), marker.
One-pixel rules, square surfaces, 2px corners on controls, circles only for records.
Three-size type ramp (12 / 13.5 / 28, plus the 20px inspector title); rank by weight, width and case.
Dense, fixed row furniture; tabular figures everywhere.
The record is the signature object: label disc in the inspector, spinning platter in the dock, blank label as the artwork placeholder.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Stamp blue is the only accent. The retired five-accent picker resolves every stored id to stamp blue; no second hue, no per-feature colour.

rules.name: The Ink Means Something Rule
rules.body: Colour appears only for selection, primary action, focus, status or loss. If a surface is coloured and none of those is true, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Three Sizes Rule
rules.body: 12, 13.5 and 28 carry the whole interface (20 for the inspector title). Rank by weight, width and case, never by adding a size.

rules.name: The Marker Means Manual Rule
rules.body: The handwritten face appears only on values the producer corrected. Using it for decoration erases its meaning.

rules.name: The Flat Stock Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest are flat paper. A shadow means the sheet has physically lifted off the page (a dialog, menu or tooltip); nothing else casts one, and nothing glows.

dos: Do draw every tempo and key value with its provenance mark, and show the legend wherever those values are read.
Do keep stamp blue (stamp-blue / stamp-blue-lifted) for selection, the primary action and focus only.
Do separate surfaces with one-pixel rules and tonal steps between stock, deep stock and sheet.
Do keep controls square with a 2px corner, and reserve circles for records and labels.
Do set headings and stamped lettering in condensed Archivo caps (72% width, 800) and keep figures tabular.
Do let only the platter animate unprompted; every other transition answers user input and honours reduced motion.
Do keep both themes first-class: every token has a stock and a vinyl value.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue, a per-feature colour, or an accent picker.
Don't use glows, gradient fills, frosted glass or ambient blurred backgrounds.
Don't use graphite panels with rounded cards; surfaces are cut square.
Don't add type sizes beyond 12 / 13.5 / 28 (and 20 for the inspector title).
Don't use the marker face for anything except a producer's manual correction.
Don't show measured confidence as a percentage or a solid value; it stays dotted with three ink dots.
Don't mark selection with a 2px coloured edge; the selection rule is 1px.
